item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera, a Class 7 student in Pune, gets her first period and feels worried. Her elder sister Asha explains what is happening. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Menstruation is an injury inside the body that needs medicine.
options.B: Menstruation is a natural body process that shows a girl's reproductive system is maturing during adolescence.
options.C: Menstruation is a shameful problem and should be kept secret from everyone.
options.D: Menstruation happens because of something wrong the girl has eaten.
